evidence.quote: Angus Innes Partner and Joint Head of Marketing Angus joined Trinity Street in 2019 and is based in the London office. Prior to Trinity Street, he was a Partner at Lansdowne Partners UK and a Managing Director at Macquarie, running their Pan-Asian Equity business in the UK & Europe where he was employed for five years. He previously ran Merrill Lynch’s Japanese Equity business in the UK & Europe and spent three years with Meiji Life Insurance in Tokyo in their Foreign Equity Investment division, investing in the Australasian market. Angus has a Bachelor of Commerce from the University of Queensland, as well as a Masters in Political Science and an MBA from the University of Cambridge.
